build: Fury Druid (Werewolf, level 1-99: leveling and endgame in one build), computed from the D2R game tables
source_url: https://github.com/blizzhackers/d2data (D2R skills.json, skilldesc.json, runes.json, misc.json, weapons.json, uniqueitems.json, setitems.json, difficultylevels.json, hireling.json) + animdata.d2 from the local d2exp.mpq
author: agent-computed from the game data, not from a guide

setup_legend.lvl a-b: The leveling plan agreed with the user (2026-11-23): one build from level 1 to 99, no stage switch and no skill reset; two-handed from level 1, natural-socket bases only, fully twinked by Vex. A leveling piece stays listed until the level its successor takes over ('lvl a-b'); one whose successor is the endgame gear stays to 99.
setup_legend.standard: The user's endgame core (unchanged): Eternity / Breath of the Dying, Fortitude, Jalal's Mane, Laying of Hands, Raven Frost; for the merc 2x Lawbringer, Smoke, Bulwark. The druid always fights two-handed, never one-handed and never with a shield.
setup_legend.alternative: User's endgame options and the Maxroll Fury Druid guide's unique/set/runeword pieces (weapons two-handed only), ranked below the stage pieces in the same slot and judged by their stats; Pride and The Reaper's Toll only for a later Act 2 Might merc after Bone Break (charm).

stat_source: Numbers computed from the D2R game tables (blizzhackers/d2data JSON, current with the Warlock class): skill formulas/params from skills.json + skilldesc.json, runewords from runes.json + misc.json, bases/WSM from weapons.json, uniques/sets from uniqueitems.json/setitems.json, life-steal divisors from difficultylevels.json. Attack frames: werewolf A1 = 13 frames at speed 256 (animdata.d2 entry 40A1HTH, classic d2exp.mpq) with the attack-speed formulas from maxroll's Attack Speed resource (primary and shapeshift equations, faster one wins since patch 2.4). Not from a build guide.

targets.lycanthropy_duration: Werewolf form lasts 1000 + Lycanthropy(1000 + 500 per level after the first) frames: 40 s without Lycanthropy, 80 s at 1, +20 s per level, 180 s at 6, 300 s (5 min) at 12, 460 s at 20. Form life bonus 25% + Lycanthropy (20% + 5% per level): 45% at 1, 100% at 12, 140% at 20. Levels include +skills: 4 hard points by ~30 with the Eye of Etlich (+1) and Lore (+1) are level 6 = 180 s; Jalal's Mane (+2 druid, +2 Shape Shifting) adds 4 more from 42.
targets.werewolf: Werewolf attack speed (skill IAS, diminishing 10..80): 20 at 1, 45 at 5, 51 at 7, 57 at 10, 64 at 15, 68 at 20; attack rating +50% +15% per level (335% at 20).
targets.feral_rage: Feral Rage (level 12): max charges 3 + level/2 (3 at 1, 4 at 2-3, 5 at 4, 8 at 10, 13 at 20); 4% life steal per charge (12/16/20/32/52%), run speed up to 32-55%, charges last 20 s. Life steal is divided by 2 in Nightmare and 3 in Hell (difficultylevels.json). The skill screen formula shows 4 to 4x level + 8% (equal to the charge formula only at levels 1-2): trust the screen in game.
targets.fury: Fury (level 30, needs Rabies > Feral Rage > Werewolf): min(level + 1, 5) hits, so 5 hits from level 4; damage +100% +17% per level (423% at 20); attack rating +50% +10% per level. The current skills.json gives Fury no synergy, so 20 hard points is all of its scaling.
targets.skill_order: One line 1-99, 110 points (98 levels + 12 quest points); a skill holds at most character level - its required level + 1 hard points: 2-11 Werewolf 10 and Lycanthropy 1 (Den of Evil); 12-29 Feral Rage 10 (its leech is full in Normal), Rabies 1 at 18, Lycanthropy to 4 hard points (effective 6 with +skills), Werewolf to 17 with Izual's points; 30-49 Fury one point per level, 20 at 49 (all of its scaling, no synergy), the Nightmare quest points finishing Werewolf 20 and starting Lycanthropy; then Lycanthropy 20, Feral Rage 20 (13 charges, 52% life steal, 17% in Hell), Oak Sage 1 and Heart of Wolverine 20 (it replaces Oak Sage); last Werebear 1 and Maul 1 (for a Metamorphosis), the 6 left into Rabies (7).
targets.ias: Werewolf attack frames (Feral Rage, normal attack, Fury's first hit), by effective Werewolf level and off-weapon IAS. Ribcracker (WSM 0, its 50% IAS counts undiminished in wolf form): 6 frames at Werewolf 1-2, 5 frames from Werewolf 3 with no other IAS (fastest of all candidates). Fury's middle hits roll the animation back 70% and are shorter; the tables can't give that sequence exactly.
targets.core_fit: From the data: Ribcracker is a two-handed Quarterstaff (level 31, 25 Str), 5 frames thanks to its 50% weapon IAS; Hone Sundan with 3 Shael (level 37, 101 Str) is 5 frames too with 45% crushing blow. The druid fights two-handed only (never one-handed, no shield). Lawbringer is one-handed (sword/hammer/scepter, level 43): both copies go to the Act 5 Frenzy merc that dual-wields one-handed swords. Smoke is always merc gear (the druid wears Stealth, Lionheart, then Fortitude); Bulwark goes to the merc when Jalal's Mane (a druid pelt) comes at 42. Laying of Hands (Bramble Mitts, level 63, 20% IAS) is part of The Disciple set.
targets.physical_immunes: Fury only deals physical damage: skip physical immunes or leave them to the merc and Rabies (poison); each of the merc's Lawbringers adds 150-210 fire and 130-180 cold.

merc.type: Act 1 Cold Arrow rogue from Act 1 until Normal Act 5 (bows: Pluckeye, Witherstring / Rimeraven, Zephyr, Edge; Isenhart's Horns, Greyform), then the Act 5 Frenzy Barbarian from Normal Act 5 on (no rehire): Strength + King's Grace, Coldsteel Eye from 31, Undead Crown, Smoke at 37, the druid's Bulwark at 42, 2x Lawbringer at the endgame; later, once Bone Break (unique charm) is owned, an Act 2 Might merc with Pride. No Act 2 merc while leveling
merc.why: hireling.json: the rogue is hireable from level 3, the Frenzy Barbarian (his own hire type) from Normal Act 5 at 28+; he is the same type as the endgame 2x Lawbringer merc, so there's no rehire. Act 2 Might (the aura on top of Fury's physical damage) only after Bone Break, since only with it does Fury hit physical immunes without the Lawbringers' Decrepify.

tips: Werewolf from level 2 with a two-handed Bardiche or Large Axe; Dimoak's Hew at 8.
Hire a Cold Arrow rogue and keep her until Normal Act 5 (no Act 2 merc): Pluckeye from 7, Isenhart's Horns and Greyform.
Open each fight with Feral Rage until the charges are up (life steal), then hit.
Strength only for gear: 70 by 12 (Sigon's Sabot), 69+ by 24 (Bonesob); no Dexterity, the rest into Vitality.
Hire the Act 5 Frenzy Barbarian in Normal Act 5 (no rehire later): Strength + King's Grace, Coldsteel Eye from 31, Undead Crown.
Strength 101 by 37 for Hone Sundan with 3 Shael.
Hand Bulwark to the merc when Jalal's Mane goes on at 42.
Life steal is a third in Hell: Bulwark on the merc, Feral Rage charges and String of Ears / Verdungo's matter.
Skip physical immunes; Rabies and the merc's Lawbringers handle them.
